Kolkata's 74-year-old Ratnabali Ghosh aka "Alpona Didi" wakes at 5:30 AM everyday to draw alpona outside strangers' doors, just to make them smile.
every day to draw traditional Bengali alpona outside strangers' doorsteps, just to make them smile.
Inspired by her mother, Ratnabali believes art is about making people feel welcome, valued and less alone. Even as age and arthritis make her work harder, she refuses to give up.
